title: The Locker
summary: Songbird asks V to climb a Dogtown roof past a patrol and fetch a locker she left years ago.
description: Before Reed brought her into Dogtown's mess, Songbird left a locker on a roof near the Black Sapphire. She asks V to climb up past the patrol and fetch it.

start.bringUp: Before Reed brought her into Dogtown's mess, Songbird left a locker on a roof near the Black Sapphire. She calls you with a favour she is embarrassed to ask: go up and get what is in it. Her information about the patrols is seven weeks old, and she admits it, then forgets to account for it.

roof.name: the roof near the Black Sapphire

locker.name: the rusted locker on that roof

S2.open.01.text: Hi. I need a favour. A stupid one.

S2.open.02.text: There's a locker on a roof near the Black Sapphire. Number nine. I think.

S2.open.03.text: Patrols were two on the east side, one on the stair. That was seven weeks ago.

S2.open.04.text: Do you trust a seven-week-old plan? Say no. It's the right answer.

S2.bark.count.a.text: The third one turns at the count of twenty.

S2.bark.count.b.text: Two on the left. Wait. Wait. Now.

S2.bark.locker.a.text: That's it. Don't open it until you're clear.

S2.listen.01.text: Read me the first track. Just the name.

S2.close.01.text: You got it. You didn't have to. I won't say it twice.

S2.close.02.text: I'm sorry about the intel. Next time I'll check twice.

S2.close.03.text: You turned back. That was the right call.

g1.asks: Do you trust a seven-week-old plan?
g1.know: You know the stash, the roof and that your patrol numbers are stale.
g1.secret: You hope V will not realise how much V matters to you.
g1.wants: V to go ahead without false confidence.

g2.asks: Read me the first track. Just the name.
g2.know: You know the tracks on the player and the feeling of each one.
g2.secret: The first track is the one you played the night before the oath.
g2.wants: To hear the name said by someone else.

stages.label: Songbird asks V to fetch her locker
stages.objective: Agree to fetch Songbird's locker from the roof
stages.know: You are calling V with a favour. You remember the roof, the locker number and the patrol rhythm, and the patrol rhythm is seven weeks old.
stages.wants: V to go up to the roof and check the patrol before going.

stages.label: Songbird counts the guards on the roof
stages.objective: Climb to the roof near the Black Sapphire past the patrol for Songbird
stages.know: V is climbing toward the roof. You can hear the patrol through V, and you count it out loud, and you are not sure the count is still right.
stages.wants: V to reach the roof without being seen.

stages.label: V opens the locker on the roof
stages.objective: Open Songbird's rusted locker on the roof
stages.know: V is at the locker. You want it open quietly, and you say very little while V works.
stages.wants: V to open the locker and take what is in it.

stages.label: Songbird asks V to read the first track
stages.objective: Read the first track name for Songbird
stages.know: V is driving away from the roof with the player. You want V to read the first track name, and you will tell V only the feeling of the track, never its real title.
stages.wants: V to read out the first track name.

quiet.memory: You went up a Dogtown roof past a patrol for Songbird's old music player and never fired a shot.
quiet.history: She asks you to keep the player.

noisy.memory: You went up a Dogtown roof for Songbird's locker, got into a fight on the way, and she apologised for her old intel.

empty-handed.memory: You turned back before the locker, and Songbird said it was the right call.

no.memory: You did not go up the roof for Songbird's locker, and she did not call for a while.
